claims.claim: The commit adds the no-argument full-suite diagnostic, its dedicated pytest observer, and regression tests; no existing files changed.

The diagnostic runs one collection and one full-suite n12 phase, then runs one serial and one n4 replay only when bounded failures were discovered. Both replays request the same failed-nodeid set, with no retry or fallback path.

The observer and driver retain up to 64 unique failure nodeids with phase, process identity, and validated typed cause facts; over-bound, duplicate, malformed, unsafe, and inconsistent observations fail closed.
The driver checks the clean Git subject around every phase, verifies collection and execution identities, and checks isolated pytest and Git fixture roots for each profile and process.
The final JSON reports full-n12 failures and the serial and n4 reproduction subsets using only the specified mechanical classifications, without a cause attribution or remediation recommendation.
The new regression tests cover pass, replay classifications, the 64-identity bound, unsafe causes, exact replay identity, and subject mutation; 15 implementation-local tests passed.
